one_liner: Snowflake has a broad REST API (SQL API, Cortex, Python API) with OAuth and PAT auth, trial accounts available, and an official managed MCP server.
auth_notes: Snowflake OAuth (and External OAuth) is supported; programmatic access tokens are static secrets users generate; key-pair JWT is also supported by Snowflake generally (from background knowledge). Each customer has own account URL.
access_notes: Snowflake offers a time-limited free trial account; ongoing use is paid consumption-based. Each customer account requires per-account setup (account identifier, OAuth security integration created by ACCOUNTADMIN).
blocker_notes: Only trial access is free; per-customer account URL and admin-created OAuth integration are needed.

evidence.quote: You can generate programmatic access tokens for human users (users with TYPE=PERSON) as well as service users (users with TYPE=SERVICE or TYPE=SERVICE_AGENT).
Snowflake OAuth by default, with optional External OAuth so MCP clients can authenticate against your organization’s identity provider.
Upgrading your account from a trial account to a paid account is required in order to create a listing.
The Snowflake-managed MCP server lets AI agents securely retrieve data from Snowflake accounts without deploying separate infrastructure.
